_doc: Widget library. A requirement in requirements.json points to ONE capability (+ dim for 'dims' capabilities). Status defaults (rr = DY Recommendations Report, er = DY Experience Report, das = DAS + BI) are used when the requirement does not set them. Full docs: .github/skills/das-demo/references/capabilities.md

impressions.summary: Impressions per slot / strategy, share and delta vs comparison period.

clicks_ctr.summary: Clicks and CTR per slot / strategy.

add_to_cart.summary: Add-to-cart of the clicked SKU after a reco click (product-level ATC attribution).

units_purchased.summary: Orders and units of the clicked SKU purchased.

conversion_rate.summary: Custom conversion rate = attributed orders / impressions.

attributed_revenue.summary: Product-level attributed revenue (click -> PDP -> order) vs DY-attributed revenue from the attribution table.

addon_revenue.summary: Add-on revenue from PDP slots vs the main (anchor) product revenue in the same orders.

product_clicks.summary: Clicks per product ID by slot / strategy (no product CTR: DAS has no SKU-level impressions).

time_comparison.summary: WoW, date range vs previous, YoY per slot / strategy.

trend.summary: Daily / weekly historical trend per slot / strategy.

product_performance.summary: Per SKU x slot/strategy: clicks, ATC, units, revenue, click->order. PARTIAL: no product impressions / CTR.

filters.summary: Filter by country, locale, device, visitor type, slot, strategy, category.

segments.summary: New vs returning, device, traffic source.

category_performance.summary: Page category (where the slot is) or recommended-product category.

bigquery_feed.summary: Architecture: S3 Parquet -> BigQuery -> SQL models -> BI tool.

product_attributes.summary: Click share and click->order by colour, material, price band, stock (feed join).

business_rule_test.summary: Uplift of each variation vs the control in every slot with an A/B test.

funnel.summary: Impression -> click -> PDP -> ATC -> order, plus main -> recommended product pairs.

coverage.summary: % of viewed PDP SKUs where each PDP slot returned recommendations.

alerts.summary: Scheduled report + WoW alert thresholds per slot.

realtime_gap.summary: Explains why DAS is not real time (D+1) and the options.

gap.summary: Generic 'not possible with DAS' panel. Uses the requirement's 'how' and optional 'options' list.
